title: One needs, running and hidden builder for ork status and the TUI
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: ork status --project ork says 'needs you 3' but lists three stopped S21 runs, two of which no longer count under #92 ui.stopped-newer, and the TUI shows only the newest. The list and the count disagree, so it is unclear what the owner must act on.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Seen 2026-10-20: ork status reports "needs you 3" but lists stopped runs that decision 92 no longer counts. The count and the list come from different rules: the count uses NeedsYou (internal/source/source.go:179-182), the text printer prints every engine run (internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:48-57), and the Overview skips committed and superseded runs on its own (internal/tui/overview.go:98). docs/dashboard.md:106-107 says the Overview and ork status share one builder; only the run list is shared.

This slice gives one builder, EngineRun.Section (needs, running or hidden), that the status printer, the Overview, the daemon count and the model all use. It also takes in the retired S42: replace the literal state strings with the runrec constants.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/source/source.go`: EngineRun (:153-163) and Superseded (:167-177). NeedsYou (:179-182) is replaced by Section; literal states at :168 and :181. Tests: `internal/source/source_test.go`.
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go:199-212`: projectStatus needs count. Tests: `internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go` (TestStoppedNeedsNewerEngineRun, :59) and `internal/daemon/daemon_test.go` (:542).
- `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:39-57`: status lines. Tests: `internal/cli/cli_test.go` (:223).
- `internal/tui/overview.go:94-132`: rows; literal "committed" at :98. `internal/tui/model.go:68-76`: needs count; :436-443: engineActive, literal at :440. Tests: `internal/tui/tui_test.go`, `internal/tui/golden_test.go`; goldens `testdata/golden/overview-*.txt` only if the rows change.
- `docs/dashboard.md:117` and `docs/design.md:630`: wording on stopped runs.
- Not changed: `internal/runrec` (constants only, record.go:27-33).

2026-10-23 re-anchor and additions (S32 preflight): source.go EngineRun :153, Superseded :187-199 (literal "stopped" :190), NeedsYou :201-204; daemon/handlers.go projectStatus :236-258 (NeedsYou count :246); cli/daemoncmds.go status loop :39-67; tui/model.go needs() :70-76 and engineActive :549-566 (literal "committed" :554); tui/overview.go row builder :112-146. New: `internal/daemon/wire.go:77-89` (ProjectStatus gains *proposed* fields `open:[{id,key,title}]` and `held:[{id,title}]`, omitempty), `internal/daemon/handlers.go:236-258` (fill them), `docs/design.md:95` and `:740-745` and `docs/dashboard.md:44` and `:146-152` (document them), and tests for the new fields. Out of scope: overview.go:524 (the Ready section). The Check rg expectation is stale: literals also remain at pane.go, model.go:756-775, runtree.go:53, overview.go:524 and cli/lifecycle.go:131; S32 changes only source.go, handlers.go, model.go engineActive and overview.go.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- source: `EngineRun.Section` gives Hidden for a committed run and for a stopped run that a newer run of the same slice supersedes; Needs for awaiting-approval, paused and a stopped run with no newer run; Running for every other state (new test `TestEngineRunSection`).
- daemon: `projectStatus` NeedsYou counts only Needs rows (extend `TestStoppedNeedsNewerEngineRun`, internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go:59).
- cli: `ork status` prints the same needs rows that the count counts, including one line for each open adj record and needs-owner item (record 125).
- cli: `ork status --json` still carries every run, superseded and committed ones too.
- cli: `TestStatusFromTheDaemonsSourceSnapshot` (internal/cli/cli_test.go:223) still passes.
- tui: for one snapshot, the Overview needs rows and the model's needs count agree, and a superseded run appears in neither section (internal/tui/tui_test.go).
- tui: the overview golden views change only where a superseded or committed run was shown before.
- The status list and the Overview hide the same runs (a superseded or committed run is in neither).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first (Failing-tests). Run `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/source ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli ./internal/tui` and confirm the new tests fail.
2. In internal/source/source.go add `type Section int` with SectionHidden, SectionNeeds and SectionRunning, and `func (r EngineRun) Section(runs []EngineRun) Section` (*proposed* names). Rules, from today's code: committed, or superseded (source.go:167-177), gives Hidden; awaiting-approval, paused, or stopped and not superseded (source.go:180-181) gives Needs; anything else gives Running.
3. Use runrec.StateStopped, StateCommitted, StatePaused and StateAwaitingApproval (internal/runrec/record.go:27-32) at source.go:168 and :181. This is the S42 constants fold-in. source may import runrec: runrec imports only registry and clirun (record.go:13, writer.go:11).
4. Move the callers to Section and delete NeedsYou (source.go:180-182): internal/daemon/handlers.go:208-211 (count Needs only); internal/tui/model.go:70-72 (needs count); internal/tui/model.go:436-443 (engineActive becomes Section == Running; the literal "committed" at :440 goes); internal/tui/overview.go:94-131 (Hidden is skipped, replacing the test at :98; Needs goes to the needs list at :126; Running to the running list).
5. internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:48-57: print only Needs and Running rows. Keep the wait and denied suffixes.
6. docs/dashboard.md:117 and docs/design.md:630 say stopped runs count as needs you. Change them to "stopped and not superseded" (record 125, ui.status-list).
7. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update` only if overview goldens change, then review testdata/golden/.
Decided: record 125 (ui.status-list). (a) Hide superseded and committed runs in the text list, as the Overview does (record 92). (b) Print open adj records and needs-owner items as one line each under their project, so the count equals the list. (c) Committed runs leave the list. (d) `ork status --json` keeps the full run list.

Decided 2026-10-23 (owner): (a) add the proposed fields to ProjectStatus; `needs_you` stays the sum of open + held + Needs-section runs; `ork status --json` carries the new fields. (b) `ork status` text lines reuse the Overview wording: `  #ID KEY  TITLE` for an adj record and `  SID  TITLE  (needs-owner)` for a held item, printed under the project line before the relay and run lines. (c) `type Section int` and `EngineRun.Section(runs)` in internal/source/source.go (names *proposed*), with runrec constants. Nothing is open.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `go test ./internal/tui -update` only if overview goldens change; then review the diff in testdata/golden/.
- `rg -n '"(stopped|committed|paused|awaiting-approval)"' internal --glob '!*_test.go'`: expect hits only in internal/runrec, internal/tui/pane.go:72 and :103, and internal/tui/model.go:551. Those are outside the S42 list and stay.
- Tests by name: TestEngineRunSection (new), TestStoppedNeedsNewerEngineRun, TestStatusListsProjectsWithNeedsYouAndActiveRelays, TestStatusFromTheDaemonsSourceSnapshot, TestEngineRunPendingWire, and the overview golden tests in internal/tui/golden_test.go.
